prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” — the best AI video ad maker depends on your goal (realistic human presenter vs fast social clips vs repurposing blog content), budget, and required features. That said, a few platforms stand out for common use cases:

Top picks and when to use them
- Synthesia — Best for realistic AI human presenters and multi‑language voiceovers (B2B explainers, product demos). Pros: polished avatars, many languages. Cons: pricier, less scene/clip variety.
- HeyGen — Good alternative to Synthesia at lower cost for talking‑head ads and scripts.
- Canva — Best for most marketers who want fast, templated social ads with brand kits and collaboration. Broad asset library and easy export to multiple aspect ratios.
- Pictory — Best for turning long-form content (blogs, webinars) into short ads; strong auto‑summarization and captioning.
- InVideo / Vimeo Create — Versatile, template-rich, affordable for marketers who want more control over scenes and transitions.
- Runway — Best for creative/experimental ads that need generative visuals or advanced editing (more for creative teams).
- Kapwing / VEED.io — Fast, affordable editors with strong captioning, resizing, and simple AI features for short social ads.
- Adobe (Premiere Pro + Sensei / Express) — Best for pros who want advanced, integrated editing and AI-assisted workflows.

How to pick the “best” for you
1. Define your priorities: presenter/avatar, speed, platform (TikTok/Meta/YouTube), languages, brand kit, price, output resolution.
2. Trial 2–3 options: almost all offer free trials or free tiers.
3. Test performance: create 3–5 variants and A/B test (CTR, view‑through rate, CPA).
4. Check legal/privacy: make sure licensing, usage rights, and deepfake policies meet your needs.

Quick recommendations by use case
- Quick, cheap social ads: Canva, InVideo, Kapwing
- Realistic human presenter / multi‑language voiceover: Synthesia or HeyGen
- Repurposing long content to ads: Pictory, Vidyo.ai
- Advanced creative effects / generative visuals: Runway or Adobe tools
- Large ad programs / optimization + analytics: consider VidMob (creative analytics) or enterprise plans from the above

If you want, tell me:
- your budget (monthly or per video)
- target platform(s) (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Meta)
- ad style (talking head, product demo, UGC look, animated text)
- languages or voiceover needs
I’ll recommend 2–3 specific tools and a simple test workflow (script + variants) you can run.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
